text:
nate: heads up — deploy-bot aborted publish for payments-service:ci-2811 -> ecr.us-west-2.redwood/payments-service:pr-2811. digest mismatch on finalize and no attestation attached.

deploy-bot: publish aborted: digest_mismatch. details:
  uploaded 5/9 layers, finalize returned digest != computed
  expected: sha256:9f33... got: sha256:9f99...
  attestation: missing
  action=abort

jen: was this also mirrored to GCR? we should check the mirror snapshot to see if it has a differing digest.

infra-bot: mirror-status: gcr-mirror-us-west shows copy present but digest differs for tag pr-2811 -> sha256:9f99... in mirror. upstream ECR has no completed manifest for that tag.

miguel: sounds like a proxy/mirror finalization issue — we've seen chunk reorder/corruption on mirror-proxy-2 before. can we pin to the last known-good digest and hold the rollout?

nate: do we have a last-known good digest for staging/prod?

deploy-bot: last successful publish for payments-service (staging) -> sha256:3ab2... (2025-10-19T03:02:11Z).

jen: plan suggestion: (1) pin current rollout to sha256:3ab2... so the deploy uses the good digest, (2) republish the CI artifact from cache to a new tag (no rebuild), (3) attach cosign + provenance attestation and verify, (4) re-run staging canary.

release-manager: approve hold. cancel the EU change window for payments-service and mark image promote as blocked. add line to release notes: "payments-service staging publish held due to manifest/digest mismatch; republish underway."

infra-bot: opened ticket INF-2030: investigate mirror-proxy-2 502 spikes and add auto-rotate if >3 errors/min. linked runbook: https://infra.internal/runbooks/mirror-proxy-corruption

miguel: quick republish commands I ran last time — reuse CI cache artifact id ci-cache-4112:
```
publishbot republish --artifact ci-cache-4112 --target-tag staging-repub-4112 --force
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/cosign-key staging-repub-4112
provenance-checker attach --artifact staging-repub-4112 --attest attestation.json
provenance-checker verify --artifact staging-repub-4112 --require-attestation
```

nate: infra, can you confirm there were no S3 multipart reassembly errors in us-west-2 between 09:15-09:18 UTC? @infra-bot

infra-bot: S3 logs show transient 502s from mirror-proxy-2 at 2025-10-19T09:16:22Z and 09:16:27Z. correlate with build fleet: build-node-42 had 2 interrupted chunk uploads.

jen: given that, republish from cache to a new tag and then run the provenance verifier. I'll take ownership of the canary once the republish + cosign pass.

deploy-bot: republish started: ci-cache-4112 -> staging-repub-4112. watch: https://publishbot.internal/redwood/ops/4112

miguel: cosign verify succeeded for staging-repub-4112 @sha256:3ab2... using kms://projects/redwood/keys/cosign-key. attestation attached. provenance-checker verify -> OK.

deploy-bot: republish completed. manifest pinned: sha256:3ab2...

jen: starting staging canary against staging-repub-4112 now. checking pulls, latencies, metric sanity.

nate: once canary is green we schedule manual promote to production in the next non-EU change window (tomorrow 06:00 UTC). release-manager, please confirm scheduling.

release-manager: confirmed. production promote blocked until post-republish verification and INF-2030 updates. will post follow-up postmortem link to changelog when ready. :thumbsup:

jen: canary passed after 30m. no pull errors, performance unchanged. ready for manual promote per release-manager.

nate: closing thread after release-manager triggers promote. leaving notes: add finalize-stage checksum retry to publishbot and add mirror-proxy auto-rotate rule.

release-manager: thanks team — hold in release notes and internal changelog. follow up in INF-2030 for long-term fix.
